name: Bill Gates
climate_rationale: Founded Breakthrough Energy and its multi-billion catalyst fund; backs advanced nuclear and climate R&D. Marked down from 10 for personal aviation footprint and a technology-not-degrowth stance some contest.
angle: Already the archetype the treaty describes — frame it as institutionalising what Breakthrough does, with a public register that pressures peers.
channel: Breakthrough Energy / Gates Foundation program staff

name: Michael Bloomberg
climate_rationale: Funded Beyond Coal, UN climate finance envoy, one of the largest private climate funders alive. Not a 10 only because the fortune itself is not climate-derived.
angle: Cap-and-commit is the logical next step from Beyond Coal; offer a founding council seat.

name: Jeff Bezos
climate_rationale: Pledged $10B Bezos Earth Fund and the Climate Pledge. Marked down for Amazon's logistics emissions and personal spaceflight/superyacht footprint.
angle: The $10B pledge is a down payment on the surplus — the treaty is the mechanism that disburses it in ten years instead of a perpetual endowment.

name: Elon Musk
climate_rationale: Tesla accelerated EV transition materially; SolarCity/energy storage too. Offset by political alignments hostile to climate policy and heavy personal jet use — the score is contested and should be argued.
angle: Frame as the accelerationist case: the treaty funds the transition Tesla exists to sell into. High-risk, high-variance contact.
notes: Score is the most disputable on the seed list — good candidate for the Telegram re-scoring.

name: Warren Buffett
climate_rationale: Giving Pledge co-founder and a committed disburser of his fortune, but Berkshire Hathaway Energy retains significant coal and BHE has resisted faster decarbonisation timelines.
angle: Already committed to giving nearly all of it away — the treaty just adds a clock and a destination. Natural philosophical ally.

name: Mukesh Ambani
climate_rationale: Fortune is oil-and-gas rooted, but Reliance has pledged a large green-energy buildout (solar, hydrogen, storage) with a net-zero-by-2035 target. Score reflects the tension between the two.
angle: The green pivot is the opening — position the treaty as the credible-commitment device that makes the net-zero pledge verifiable.

name: Gautam Adani
climate_rationale: Among the world's largest private coal developers, while simultaneously building one of the largest renewables portfolios. Net position is heavily fossil-weighted today.
angle: Hard case. Renewables arm is the only bridge; treat as low-probability, long-horizon.

name: Charles Koch
climate_rationale: Long and documented record of funding organisations that oppose climate policy and cast doubt on climate science. Fortune is petrochemical-rooted.
notes: Listed as the low anchor of the 0–10 scale, not as a prospect.
